Job Title: Business Analyst/QA Specialist Job Description The Business Analyst/QA Specialist plays a key role in translating business, user, and product needs into clear, actionable requirements that support software and platform development in a complex, compliance-driven environment. This position partners closely with product, engineering, and quality assurance teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and fully traceable across the system lifecycle. Responsibilities Elicit, analyze, and document business, user, and product requirements that capture functional, non-functional, and compliance-related needs. Partner with Product Owners, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure requirements are technically sound, testable, and interconnected across systems. Analyze how requirements impact one another and identify dependencies, constraints, and interactions within integrated system components. Ensure compliance-driven and policy-related requirements are accurately reflected and traceable throughout the system lifecycle. Support QA processes by linking requirements to test cases and validation criteria to achieve complete coverage and end-to-end traceability. Maintain organized, high-quality documentation across Jira, Confluence, and related collaboration and tracking tools. Facilitate requirement review sessions to confirm accuracy, resolve ambiguities, and promote shared understanding across delivery teams. Interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies to inform requirement design and impact analysis. Collaborate with stakeholders from both technical and business domains to align requirements with strategic objectives and user needs. Essential Skills Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst supporting software or platform development. Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Proven experience in requirements gathering and documentation across business, user, and product domains. Strong understanding of how business, user, and product requirements interrelate within complex system environments. Technical fluency sufficient to interpret data flows, system integrations, and functional dependencies. Experience supporting QA workflows and maintaining requirements-to-test-case traceability. Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to break down complex problems and define clear, structured requirements. Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences and facilitate collaborative discussions. Ability to ensure compliance and security-related requirements are incorporated into system design and documentation. Additional Skills & Qualifications Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, documentation, and collaboration. Experience supporting government programs or compliance-driven software delivery initiatives. Knowledge of NIST standards, FedRAMP

Job Title: Business Analyst Location: Boston, MA Hybrid Work Arrangement: Hybrid Duration: 1+ Year Role Summary The client is seeking a Business Analyst with strong Prior Authorization (PA) expertise to support MMIS initiatives within a large healthcare benefits environment. The role focuses on claims processing, provider reimbursement, requirements management, testing, implementation support, and stakeholder collaboration for projects supporting member services and regulatory compliance. Key Responsibilities Lead and participate in joint application design sessions with business stakeholders. Gather, document, analyze, and validate business and system requirements. Support design, development, testing, implementation, and stabilization activities across MMIS projects. Develop testing strategies, test scenarios, and test cases; execute and review testing activities. Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to ensure business requirements are fully defined and validated. Communicate project updates, system changes, and impacts to stakeholders. Provide MMIS functional support and respond to business questions and concerns. Perform data analysis and data query activities to support project objectives. Required Qualifications Business analysis experience supporting multiple phases of the SDLC. Strong healthcare claims processing knowledge, including Prior Authorization (PA), PAS, and referrals. Experience working with Medicaid programs, healthcare payer environments, or MMIS platforms. Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities. Experience creating requirements documentation, test cases, and testing strategies. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with business, technical, QA, and vendor teams. Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, IT, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline, plus relevant experience. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of Agile methodologies. Understanding of HIPAA claims and payment transaction processing. Familiarity with interoperability concepts and X12 transaction standards. Previous state Medicaid or government healthcare program experience. Additional Information Hybrid work arrangement with onsite expectations. Focused on regulated healthcare systems supporting Medicaid operations. Candidate should be comfortable engaging with multiple stakeholder groups and vendors. Business Goal: Support enhancements, compliance-driven changes, testing, and implementation efforts impacting member-facing healthcare services. Hidden Priority: Domain expertise in Medicaid claims operations appears more important than generic BA experience. Potential Knockout Factors: Lack of PA/claims processing experience, MMIS exposure, Medicaid knowledge, or SQL/d
